purpose: Give RAG/agent builders a compact safety bundle for file metadata, zero-argument tools, and output contracts.

checks.risk: arbitrary file read via metadata path
checks.gate: reject absolute paths, parent traversal, home/secrets paths unless explicitly consented

checks.risk: tool schema violates provider spec when no parameters are declared
checks.gate: emit explicit empty object schema with additionalProperties=false

checks.risk: RAG agent returns prose when caller expects structured output
checks.gate: validate response against declared output schema before publishing

maintainer_attachment: Attach this bundle plus scanner outputs to RAG/tool safety issues.
